images.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Produce a NEW premium fantasy game UI art-direction sheet in landscape 16:9. The reference is our previous UI for the same cozy red-panda shop and forest-dungeon game. It is a continuity guide only. The new design must be a clearly different art direction, not a recolor or another set of beveled green-header metal rectangles.
Arrange EXACTLY FOUR front-facing tall empty card designs in a single row. Equal dimensions, clean aligned baseline, visible outer silhouettes, comfortable gutters. Each card has generous blank content area with no skill illustration or placeholder text. Under the frames place the exact Chinese rarity labels, left-to-right "普通", "稀有", "史诗", "传说". The PRIMARY border accent must respectively be pearl-white/silver, sapphire-blue, amethyst-purple, amber/orange-gold. These hues must be visibly distinct, not drowned by a universal gold frame. Retain natural leaves as subtle shared motif. Put the rarity labels outside the cards so card templates stay text-free.
At the bottom show THREE matching small refresh buttons, normal, hovered, disabled, each labeled exactly "刷新选项" with a circular two-arrow icon, with small labels underneath "默认", "悬停", "不可用". No price or count. High readability, no characters or scenery, no watermark. Avoid generic mobile loot-box styling, fluorescent full-card glow, cluttered wings/spikes, skulls and sci-fi. This is a labeled design review sheet, not a runtime texture atlas.
Art direction B: "古籍羊皮纸". Put this exact Chinese title at top. Imagine precious botanical field-journal pages from a medieval apothecary: LIGHT WARM IVORY parchment cards on a muted warm olive-paper presentation background, thin dark-brown leather binding or folded page edge, tiny embossed botanical drawings and delicate ink leaf borders. Cards have softly clipped page corners, a subtle paper-layer lip, an understated little fabric bookmark from the top, small circular wax/metal seal. Rarity identity uses a narrow double-line colored foil inset, a matching bookmark and seal accent. Common is silvery white, rare azure blue, epic muted rich violet, legendary orange gold. Bodies remain bright pale parchment even at legendary. NO dark-green header blocks, NO large gilded top crests, NO chunky metallic beveled frame. Natural gold usage restrained, matte tactile surfaces, soft short shadows, handmade scholarly warmth. Empty decorative title cartouche is integrated in the PAPER, not a dark panel. Buttons are low-profile cream-paper and slim leather-edged plaques with fine gold botanical ink and dark green labels; hover subtly illuminated colored foil. Visually lighter, calmer and more literary than the prior reference.

Use case: ui-mockup. Generate a finished 16:9 GAME UI screenshot concept for Little Red Panda's Shop. Input image 1 is the NEW visual family to implement EXACTLY. Input image 2 is the previous full-screen example and should guide ONLY layout, skill content, scene atmosphere and comparison scale; do NOT copy its card frame style.
Background: softly defocused and darkened sunlit ancient forest stone courtyard with moss and warm lamps, high isometric gameplay camera, no distracting close character. Header centered "选择你的成长", subtitle "选择一项能力，强化本次冒险".
Exactly THREE full-size equal-height portrait choice cards aligned horizontally in the center, front-on, comfortably inside the screen. Place ONE independent button centered BELOW the three cards, with circular two-arrow refresh icon and exact Chinese label "刷新选项"; smaller caption below "重新生成本次候选". No refresh cost or count, no fourth choice.
The THREE cards contain the same content as the comparison reference, left-to-right:
1 BLUE rare: label "稀有"; title "挥刀剑气"; status "新能力"; description lines "近战挥击释放剑气。" / "沿攻击方向飞行。"; small footer button "选择此升级". Illustration: elegant steel sword and pale curved wind slash, restrained leaves.
2 PURPLE epic: label "史诗"; title "投射物分裂"; status "升级至 2 级"; description "投射物向两侧分裂。" / "适用于剑气与箭矢。"; footer "选择此升级". Illustration: three diverging pale-gold arrow trails.
3 AMBER GOLD legendary: label "传说"; title "回响连锁"; status "新能力"; description "打击在附近目标间传递。" / "形成连续的回响。"; footer "选择此升级". Illustration: three linked ornate circular sigils and curling gold energy. No fixed lightning element.
Organize rarity name, skill illustration, skill name, status and effect in a very clear hierarchy. Skill illustration should occupy at most upper ONE THIRD of content, leave breathing room for a longer effect description and two-line skill title. Text must be large readable, exactly Chinese as requested. Footer selection buttons smaller than the shared refresh control. Center card can show a restrained hover cue, preserving PURPLE hue, never a selected checkmark. Do not invent numbers or unrelated interface. No watermark, no generic modern mobile game UI, no giant glow clouds.
STYLE B "古籍羊皮纸": faithfully implement image 1's light botanical manuscript book-page card templates. All three cards remain warm ivory paper with brown leather binding along one side, subtle layered page corners, tiny leaf ink engravings, a matching blue/purple/amber fabric bookmark hanging from the upper left and round leaf seal on upper right. Thin colored foil double-line frame, no thick glowing metal border and no dark green header bar. Place rarity text in the small paper cartouche below the bookmark. Skill icons are delicately painted on paper inside an understated circular botanical ink vignette, dark evergreen/brown text on light paper. Buttons are small warm parchment plaques with thin leather surrounds and dark-green labels. The entire effect is a cherished field-journal or botanical grimoire, inviting, literary, handmade, clear paper readability. Show slight color foil glint on the hovered middle card, not a neon outline.

Art direction C: "森林珐琅与藤蔓". Put this exact Chinese title at top. Dark LUMINOUS DEPTH rather than parchment: all four cards have solid deep ink-green enamel faces, subtle brushed jade grain with restrained faint botanical embossing, smoothly arched narrow top and elegant rounded lower corners. Slim intertwining silver/bronze vine wirework forms the organic frame, little natural leaves grow from two corners, one SMALL polished leaf-shaped colored inset at the apex. Rarity colors visibly run along the narrow outer vine-line: pearl-white/silver, blue, purple, amber gold. Card middle stays clean dark emerald and unobstructed, no bright parchment panel at all, no separate rectangular header band, no giant central ornaments, no huge crest. Thin gracefully curved forms, premium artisanal metal and dark enamel, limited soft edge glow, quiet shadow. Legendary can add one delicate double vine loop but must remain slim and usable. Presentation background dark desaturated pine with subtle vignette. Buttons are smooth dark-jade enamel capsules with curling vine corners, a fine silver/antique-gold outline and ivory Chinese text; hover adds a restrained edge glint, disabled has lower saturation. This must look clearly different from the blocky original fantasy card family: refined organic arch, dark typography-ready face, restrained ornament.
